mapper.select: SELECT * FROM students WHERE last_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{lastName}, '%')

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO students(last_name, first_name, last_name_furigana, first_name_furigana, nickname, email, prefecture, age, gender, remark, is_deleted) VALUES(#{lastName}, #{firstName}, #{lastNameFurigana}, #{firstNameFurigana}, #{nickname}, #{email}, #{prefecture}, #{age}, #{gender}, #{remark}, false)

mapper.update: UPDATE students SET last_name = #{lastName}, first_name = #{firstName}, last_name_furigana = #{lastNameFurigana}, first_name_furigana = #{firstNameFurigana}, nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, prefecture = #{prefecture}, age = #{age}, gender = #{gender}, remark = #{remark}, is_deleted = #{isDeleted} WHERE id = #{id}
